Warehousing

Rotation des stocks

A key performance indicator (KPI) in warehousing and supply chain that measures how many times inventory is sold or used during a period, reflecting operational efficiency and inventory management effectiveness.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Rotation des stocks?

In this glossary, Rotation des stocks refers to: A key performance indicator (KPI) in warehousing and supply chain that measures how many times inventory is sold or used during a period, reflecting operational efficiency and inventory management effectiveness.

How is Rotation des stocks used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Un taux élevé de rotation des stocks indique une gestion efficace des stocks et une forte demande de produits dans l’ensemble de la chaîne d’approvisionnement."

Why does Rotation des stocks matter in logistics?

Rotation des stocks matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Rotation des stocks?

Rotation des stocks is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Rotation des stocks belong to?

In this glossary, Rotation des stocks is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A key performance indicator (KPI) in warehousing and supply chain that measures how many times inventory is sold or used during a period, reflecting operational efficiency and inventory management effectiveness.

Operational example

A high inventory turnover ratio indicates efficient inventory management and strong product demand throughout the supply chain.

Localized term

Rotation des stocks

Localized example

Un taux élevé de rotation des stocks indique une gestion efficace des stocks et une forte demande de produits dans l’ensemble de la chaîne d’approvisionnement.
